---
title: "Image redaction"
---

::: {.status-box .status-complete}
**Status: Production**

Reviewed for MethodMesh native use and ODK intent launch. This capability is intended for removing visible identifying or sensitive regions before an image leaves MethodMesh.
:::

## Purpose

`image.redact` captures or selects an image, displays it with a configurable grid, lets the operator mark cells for masking, and returns only the redacted image plus compact mask metadata.

It is paired in the dashboard with the scaled photo selector under:

```text
Image annotation and redaction
```

The distinction is:

- `scaled_photo.capture` preserves the original and returns an annotated copy;
- `image.redact` uses the original transiently and returns only the redacted output.

## Capability ID

- `image.redact`

## Inputs

| Input | Description |
|---|---|
| `input_source` | `camera` or `file_picker`. |
| `input_grid_rows` | Number of redaction grid rows. |
| `input_grid_columns` | Number of redaction grid columns. |
| `input_redaction_style` | `black` or `white`. |

## Example intent calls

### Redact a new camera image

```text
com.example.methodmesh.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='image.redact',input_source='camera',input_grid_rows='10',input_grid_columns='10',input_redaction_style='black',input_payload_mode='FULL',return_mode='flat')
```

The production XLSForm example uses `input_payload_mode='FULL'` so the caller receives the redacted image URI plus `methodmesh_full_json` audit metadata.

### Redact a picked image

```text
com.example.methodmesh.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='image.redact',input_source='file_picker',input_grid_rows='12',input_grid_columns='12',input_redaction_style='black',input_payload_mode='FULL',return_mode='flat')
```

## Returned fields

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `image_redaction_status` | `succeeded` or failure status. |
| `redacted_image_uri` | Returned image attachment URI. |
| `redacted_image_name` | Suggested attachment filename. |
| `redaction_mask_json` | Selected grid cells. |
| `redacted_cells` | Number of selected cells. |
| `redaction_grid_rows` | Grid rows used. |
| `redaction_grid_columns` | Grid columns used. |
| `redaction_style` | Mask colour used. |
| `redaction_input_source` | Camera or file picker. |
| `redaction_created_time_iso` | Redaction creation time. |
| `image_redaction_error` | Error message, if any. |
| `methodmesh_full_json` | Full audit JSON when requested with full payload mode. |

## Geometry behaviour

The redaction grid is aligned to the displayed image bounds, not to the surrounding panel. This matters when the image aspect ratio does not match the available screen area: blank padding around the image is ignored, and cell selection maps to the actual image pixels.

Camera captures are decoded with EXIF orientation before display so portrait and landscape photos should appear in the orientation in which they were taken. Picked images use the same orientation-aware loading path.

## Direct MethodMesh use

From the dashboard, use:

- **Test** to run without saving output;
- **Test and save** to create the normal output package;
- the last-result preview to confirm the returned redacted image visually.

Saved output packages contain one canonical JSON file plus the returned redacted image attachment.

Native sharing is media-first: sharing from the result screen sends only the redacted image. The JSON remains available through save/export and through ODK full-payload returns.

## ODK example

- [`example_odk_image.redact.xlsx`](../examples/example_odk_image.redact.xlsx)

## Limitations

- Redaction is currently grid-based rather than freehand.
- The original image is not returned by this capability.
- The capability does not yet perform automatic face or text detection; masking is operator-directed.
